# Reader format engines

These local files run without CDN access. `LOCK.json` pins every engine file by
version, original package integrity (npm packages), byte size and SHA256. Foliate
is pinned to a source commit. Run `python scripts/vendor-reader-formats-r659.py`
to verify; `--fetch` reproduces the pinned files without installing packages.

- Foliate MOBI/KF8 adapter: MIT, commit 78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1.
- djvu-rs 0.43.0 scalar WASM: MIT. No DjVuLibre component is shipped.
- Mammoth 1.13.0 browser bundle: BSD-2-Clause. Its upstream production and
  browser support module notices are included in `licenses/`.
- libarchive.js 2.0.2: MIT wrapper; Comlink Apache-2.0. The bundled WASM build's
  upstream recipe uses libarchive 3.7.2, zlib 1.3, bzip2 1.0.8, XZ/liblzma
  5.2.11 and OpenSSL 1.0.2s. Their notices are included in `licenses/`.
  Emscripten runtime notice is also included; its exact upstream compiler
  version is not provided by this npm release.

This product includes software developed by the OpenSSL Project for use in the
OpenSSL Toolkit (https://www.openssl.org/). This product includes cryptographic
software written by Eric Young (eay@cryptsoft.com) and software written by
Tim Hudson (tjh@cryptsoft.com).

See each component's LICENSE and `LICENSES.json` for complete license text,
copyright, source URL and notice hash. Optional upstream tooling/development
dependencies are not installed. The immutable upstream browser bundles, rather
than an inferred transitive dependency version list, define the shipped code.

The additional parsers are necessary for KF8, DOCX, DjVu and RAR/TAR inputs that
the existing PDF.js/EPUB adapter and Go standard library cannot render. They do
not change the application's framework, original files or timer ownership.
